description: Turn a YouTube URL into an article with a title, excerpt, HTML, and Markdown. Costs one YouTube-to-Article credit. If the call is slow, call get_youtube_transcript first, then call this tool again with url and transcript. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

include_embed.description: Pin the original YouTube embed at the top. Default true.

length.description: Target length. auto lets the model size to the source.

transcript.description: Optional caption text from get_youtube_transcript so this call skips the caption fetch.

url.description: A YouTube URL (watch / youtu.be / shorts / mobile) or a raw 11-char video ID.

name: generate_youtube_article
title: Generate YouTube article
